claims: Laguna Beach premieres April 10, 2026, on The Roku Channel.
Laguna Beach includes a red-carpet event.

Lauren Conrad, Kristin Cavallari, Stephen Colletti, Lo Bosworth, Talan Torriero, Trey Phillips, Christina Schuller, Dieter Schmitz, Jessica Smith, Alex Hooser, and Morgan Smith are returning cast members for The Reunion: Laguna Beach.
The cast discusses their lives 20 years later in The Reunion: Laguna Beach.
Laguna Beach is executive-produced by several original cast members, including Lauren Conrad, Kristin Cavallari, and Stephen Colletti.
Lauren Conrad and Stephen Colletti participated in a TikTok trend with Talan Torriero during the press event.
Lauren Conrad noted, "I'm finally at the place now where I can laugh at it and say I was 18".
